text_excerpt: Research - Bennotx Search for: Home Research Benno About us News Events Search for: Contact Research Bennotx > Research Doubling of survival chances in dogs with bladder cancer due to vaccine Benno Therapeutics – Advancing Cancer Care for Dogs Cancer is one of the most common and devastating diseases in companion animals. An estimated one in four dogs will develop cancer during their lifetime, with risk increasing significantly in dogs over the age of six. Despite this high prevalence, treatment options often remain limited, burdensome, or ineffective, especially for aggressive tumor types. Benno Therapeutics is dedicated to changing this. We are developing a new class of immunotherapies based on the iBOOST platform, originally created at Amsterdam UMC, to provide safer and more effective cancer treatments for dogs. A Novel Approach: Targeting Tumor Blood Vessels, Not the Tumor Traditional cancer treatments focus on destroying tumor cells directly. However, cancer cells mutate rapidly, often developing resistance to therapy.
